$note: Deploy manifest — every live deployment this repo is responsible for.
Read by scripts/deploy-all.ts (`npm run deploy:all`). See docs/deploy-protocol.md.
NO SECRET VALUES LIVE HERE. This file is committed. The `credentials` block on
each target records only WHERE a secret is registered and WHAT it is called —
never the value. The deploy script never reads, prints, or transmits secrets;
Worker secrets are set out-of-band with `wrangler secret put`.
`account_id` IS here, deliberately duplicated from wrangler.jsonc. It is an
identifier, not a credential (it appears in dashboard URLs). The duplication is
the point: deploy-all.ts asserts the two files agree before deploying anything,
so an edit to one without the other fails loudly instead of silently deploying
to the wrong account — the failure mode of incident 2026-09-12-01.

credentials.note: Registry names, not values. AI_PROVIDER_KEY is Venkat's personal Anthropic key (see Code/.env.keys).
Registry names, not values. PI keys are deliberately NOT stored in Code/.env.keys. Billing crosscurrent: worker infra is org-billed, but AI_PROVIDER_KEY is Venkat's personal Anthropic key.
